styleLock.direction: high-contrast editorial fashion magazine system for a womens outerwear detail page
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two backgrounds only, alternating: a weathered painted concrete mural wall with large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A rendered out of focus, and a flat #F7F5F2 editorial print panel carrying drop-shadowed photo cards; never a third background language
styleLock.lightingSystem: low-key directional soft key from camera left at 4500K with negative fill on the shadow side and a texture-reading rim light on all mural shots; even high-key 5500K with near-flat shadow on the #F7F5F2 infographic panels; the key direction never flips inside a single shot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: painted exterior concrete for worn shots, matte #F7F5F2 paper field for layout pages; every hanging or flat-lay garment keeps a real contact shadow, nothing floats
styleLock.typography: two tiers only: a high-contrast serif masthead for section titles and one geometric sans-serif for labels and numerals, copy in #2D2D2D, masthead 32-48pt, labels 10-14pt, all Chinese text wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: flat solid circular seal badges in #9E2A30 holding one short Chinese word, plus thin double zig-zag rules beneath mastheads; no 3D icons, no line illustration, no emoji
styleLock.presentationRules: outerwear always worn open-front with relaxed or crossed arms; stable garment scale and a consistent head-to-hem crop across look shots; the reference garments two contrasting surface textures must stay readable; hanger and flat-lay shots share one angle family
noDrift: no new badge or icon styles
no QR codes, store badges or member entry points
no invented measurements, materials or certifications
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: high-contrast editorial fashion magazine system for a womens outerwear detail page; fixed palette of #F7F5F2 print panel, #2D2D2D text, #5A5F63 neutral mid-tone and one #9E2A30 crimson accent; cool color temperature throughout; two type tiers only, a high-contrast serif masthead and one geometric sans-serif for labels, never a third font; backgrounds alternate strictly between a weathered painted concrete mural wall with large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A shot out of focus and a flat #F7F5F2 editorial print panel with drop-shadowed photo cards; lighting is a low-key directional soft key from camera left at 4500K with negative fill and a texture-reading rim light, switching to even high-key 5500K on the print panels, and the key direction never flips within a shot; graphic devices are limited to flat circular seal badges in #9E2A30 and thin double zig-zag rules under mastheads; garment worn open-front with stable scale, consistent crop and real contact shadows; no palette changes, no third font, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no new badge styles, no QR codes, no store badges, no invented specs.

shots.displayName: 涂鸦墙前仰拍封面首图
shots.intent: 用杂志封面式的人像气场在详情页第一屏换取停留与下滑。
shots.camera: photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, body turned to a three-quarter view, framed from the knees up
shots.lighting: low-key soft directional key from camera left at 4500K, negative fill on the shadow side, cool rim light separating the garment edge
shots.background: weathered painted concrete mural wall, large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A, out of focus at f/2.8
shots.props: one wide-brim felt hat and one long fine-gauge knit underdress, no other props
shots.whitespace: clean upper band reserved for the masthead
shots.textZone: oversized serif masthead across the top reading 「{callout_1}」; one short label at upper right reading 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Editorial magazine-cover fashion photograph of {product} worn open-front. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: stop the scroll on the first detail-page screen with magazine attitude. Composition: model turned to a three-quarter view, arms crossed low, framed from the knees up, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward. Lighting: low-key soft directional key from camera left at 4500K with negative fill on the shadow side and a rim light that separates the garment edge from the wall. Background: weathered painted concrete mural wall with large abstract color fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A, out of focus at f/2.8. Props: one wide-brim felt hat and one long fine-gauge knit underdress, nothing else. The worn garment occupies 60-70% of the frame. Text zone: oversized serif masthead across the top reading 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D, one short label at upper right reading 「{selling_point_1}」. Real fabric texture, unretouched skin, 4K commercial fashion quality. Negative: no watermark, no QR code, no store or member badge, no brand logo, no recognizable real person, no text beyond the two placeholders, no dense body copy, no cut-off hem, no smoothed plastic fabric, no duplicated mural shapes, no contradictory shadow direction.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心主张：同一件外套上两种相反质面的撞质拼接。
shots.camera: flat overhead view of the printed page; the portrait card inside it is a straight-on eye-level three-quarter view
shots.lighting: even high-key 5500K studio light across the panel, near-flat shadow, one soft drop shadow under each photo card
shots.background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel with one crimson rule and thin zig-zag divider
shots.props: two drop-shadowed photo cards, one cropped from the worn look and one texture macro strip
shots.textZone: serif masthead centered under the top rule reading 「{callout_2}」; vertical label stack at left reading 「{selling_point_2}」; short label under the macro strip reading 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce editorial layout page presenting {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: state the one core claim in a second, the deliberate collision of two opposite surface textures on the same garment. Composition: flat overhead view of a printed page, a vertical label stack on the left third, a drop-shadowed portrait card on the right showing a straight-on eye-level three-quarter view, and a narrow texture macro strip beneath it. Lighting: even high-key 5500K, near-flat shadow, one soft drop shadow under each card. Background: flat #F7F5F2 panel with one #9E2A30 rule and a thin double zig-zag divider. Props: two photo cards only. The garment and its cards occupy 50-60% of the frame. Text zone: centered serif masthead reading 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, left vertical label reading 「{selling_point_2}」, macro caption reading 「{callout_3}」 at 12pt. Crisp print-quality typography, clean grid alignment. Negative: no watermark, no brand logo, no QR code, no text outside the three placeholders, no paragraph body copy, no third background, no mixed font tiers, no floating cards without drop shadow.

shots.intent: 把秋冬外套最容易被拒绝的问题——上身显厚重、肩线撑不开——做成一眼可读的视觉对照。
shots.camera: split screen, both halves photographed straight-on at eye level with identical framing and crop
shots.lighting: left half lower-key and flatter with a diffuse overhead fill, right half the locked camera-left key at 4500K with rim light; both halves share one shadow direction
shots.background: left half a plain #5A5F63 studio wall, right half the painted mural fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A out of focus
shots.props: none on the left, one wide-brim felt hat on the right
shots.whitespace: center gutter kept clear for the dividing rule
shots.textZone: one short label above each half, left reading 「{callout_4}」 and right reading 「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen showing {product} on the right half. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: agitate the everyday friction of cold-season outerwear looking bulky and shapeless at the shoulder. Composition: two matched panels divided by a thin vertical rule, both straight-on at eye level with identical framing and crop; left panel a generic shapeless outerwear silhouette with no branding, right panel the same body wearing the reference garment open-front with a long clean drape. Lighting: left half flatter and lower-key with a diffuse overhead fill, right half the camera-left 4500K key with a rim light; one consistent shadow direction across both panels. Background: #5A5F63 plain wall on the left, out-of-focus mural fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A on the right. Props: one wide-brim felt hat on the right only. The garments occupy 40-50% of the frame. Text zone: a 12pt label above each panel, left 「{callout_4}」 and right 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D. Honest visual contrast only. Negative: no fabricated results, no competitor or brand logo, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no differing camera heights between panels, no mismatched shadow direction, no deformed hands.

shots.intent: 用真实街头的侧面行走瞬间让人代入穿着场景，并交代坎肩的侧面垂坠与开襟走势。
shots.camera: photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, full body visible head to hem, mid-stride
shots.lighting: directional soft key from camera left at 4500K, cool ambient bounce from the wall, natural falloff into the shadow side
shots.background: painted concrete mural wall, abstract fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A, readable but slightly soft at f/4
shots.props: wide-brim felt hat and one small structured hand bag held low, no signage
shots.textZone: one short vertical label along the empty wall side reading 「{selling_point_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: Full-body street-style lifestyle photograph of {product} worn open-front. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let the buyer project herself into the wearing moment and read the side drape and open front of the silhouette. Composition: photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, full body visible head to hem, caught mid-stride with a candid off-center frame, feet fully inside the image. Lighting: directional soft key from camera left at 4500K with cool ambient bounce off the wall and natural falloff on the shadow side. Background: painted concrete mural wall with abstract fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A, readable but slightly soft at f/4. Props: wide-brim felt hat and one small structured hand bag held low, no signage. The garment occupies 40-50% of the frame with real contact shadow under the shoes. Text zone: one short vertical label on the emptier wall side reading 「{selling_point_4}」. Natural skin texture, slight film grain, plausible street light. Negative: no watermark, no brand logo, no shopfront lettering, no readable signage, no QR code, no text beyond the placeholder, no floating feet, no deformed hands, no over-smoothed skin, no duplicated background motifs.

shots.intent: 用微距证明做工与质感：两种质面的交界处缝合干净、毛面蓬松不倒伏。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the seam line, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light from camera left at 4500K skimming across the surface to expose fiber depth and the sheen difference, one restrained highlight, no blowout
shots.background: the garment itself fills the frame, out-of-focus #5A5F63 field at the edges
shots.textZone: one caption label at the lower edge reading 「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the boundary where the garments two contrasting surface textures meet. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: prove material and construction quality at a glance. Composition: extreme close-up macro photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down along the seam line, seam running diagonally, foreground sharp with shallow depth of field. Lighting: raking side light from camera left at 4500K skimming the surface to expose fiber depth and the sheen difference between the two fields, one restrained highlight and no blowout. Background: the fabric itself fills the frame with an out-of-focus #5A5F63 field at the edges. Props: none. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Text zone: one 12pt caption at the lower edge reading 「{callout_5}」 in #2D2D2D. Macro sharpness, individual fibers resolvable. Negative: no blurry subject, no watermark, no brand logo, no label text redraw, no invented fiber detail, no extra text, no plastic smoothed texture, no duplicated seam lines.

shots.intent: 把最容易暴露成本的边缘部位——袖口、门襟、滚边——单独放大，消除质量疑虑。
shots.camera: close-up detail shot at wrist level, horizontal side view of the cuff and open front edge, one hand relaxed inside frame
shots.lighting: soft directional key from camera left at 4500K with a small bounce card lifting the shadow side, edge highlight tracing the trim
shots.background: flat #F7F5F2 editorial panel with a thin #9E2A30 rule at the top
shots.whitespace: right third kept clear for the label stack
shots.textZone: two stacked labels at the right reading 「{callout_6}」 and 「{selling_point_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up craftsmanship detail of {product} focusing on the cuff and the open front edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove quality doubt by showing the cheapest-to-finish areas finished properly. Composition: close-up detail shot at wrist level, horizontal side view of the cuff meeting the open front edge, one relaxed hand inside the frame with natural knuckles and five clean fingers. Lighting: soft directional key from camera left at 4500K with a small bounce card lifting the shadow side and a thin edge highlight tracing the trim. Background: flat #F7F5F2 panel with one thin #9E2A30 rule at the top. Props: none beyond the hand. The detail occupies 55-60% of the frame. Text zone: two stacked 12pt labels on the clear right third reading 「{callout_6}」 and 「{selling_point_5}」 in #2D2D2D. Stitch-level sharpness. Negative: no deformed or fused fingers, no retouched skin, no watermark, no brand logo, no text beyond the two placeholders, no invented hardware, no floating sleeve without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一次交代正面、侧面、背面三个面的廓形与落点，替买家回答上身到底是什么样。
shots.camera: three matched panels of the same body wearing {product}: left at a slight 3/4 angle showing the full front facade, center from a clean 90-degree side profile, right from behind at a 45-degree rear angle
shots.lighting: identical low-key camera-left 4500K key with rim light in all three panels; only the body rotates
shots.background: continuous painted mural wall with fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A, same distance and blur in all three panels
shots.props: wide-brim felt hat in all three panels, nothing added
shots.textZone: masthead above the triptych reading 「{callout_7}」; one 12pt label under each panel naming front, side and back
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce three-panel comparison layout of {product} worn open-front. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: answer what the silhouette looks like from every side before purchase. Composition: three matched panels with identical framing and crop, same body height and same head-to-hem cut; left panel a slight 3/4 angle showing the full front facade, center panel a clean 90-degree side profile, right panel behind at a 45-degree rear angle. Lighting: identical low-key camera-left 4500K key with rim light in all three panels so only the body rotates. Background: continuous painted mural wall with abstract fields #2E6A86 and #B4693A at the same distance and blur in all three panels. Props: wide-brim felt hat only, unchanged across panels. Each garment occupies 35-40% of its panel. Text zone: serif masthead above the triptych reading 「{callout_7}」 and one 12pt label under each panel in #2D2D2D. Consistent scale across panels. Negative: no mismatched panel heights, no differing camera distance, no inconsistent lighting between panels, no duplicated garment parts, no watermark, no brand logo, no extra text, no cut-off hem, no fabricated claims.

shots.intent: 让买家在同一版式里比色比质面，直接完成选款决策。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level row of the garment shown in its available colorways, identical angle in every column
shots.lighting: even high-key 5500K with a gentle camera-left falloff, identical exposure on every column so the deeper colorways keep texture
shots.background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel divided by hairline rules
shots.props: one color chip square under each column
shots.textZone: masthead reading 「{callout_8}」; one small label under each color chip rendered from the colorway names supplied in the product data
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant row of {product} shown in its available colorways. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let the buyer choose a colorway without opening another listing. Composition: straight-on eye-level row of the same garment in each offered colorway, identical angle, identical crop and identical scale column by column, one small square color chip centered under each column. Lighting: even high-key 5500K with a gentle camera-left falloff, identical exposure across columns so deeper colorways keep their surface texture. Background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel divided by hairline rules. Props: color chips only. The garments occupy 70-80% of the frame overall. Text zone: serif masthead reading 「{callout_8}」 in #2D2D2D plus one 10pt label under each chip taken verbatim from the supplied colorway names. Accurate color reproduction. Negative: no invented colorways, no color shift between columns, no mixed lighting, no watermark, no brand logo, no extra text, no duplicated garment, no lost texture in deeper colors.

shots.intent: 用平铺尺寸与四轴指数消解尺码疑虑，减少售前咨询与退换。
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, garment laid flat and squared to the grid
shots.lighting: even high-key 5500K from the camera axis, minimal shadow, one thin contact shadow along the flat-lay edges
shots.background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel with a hairline measurement grid
shots.props: one plain wooden hanger outside the grid, nothing else
shots.whitespace: structured right column reserved for the spec grid
shots.textZone: masthead reading 「{callout_9}」; four horizontal index scales labeled 「厚薄」「版型」「衣长」「弹力」 with five tick words and one solid triangular marker each; a five-column size grid whose header and every cell value come from the supplied product data rather than being invented
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic specification screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove size doubt before the buyer asks. Composition: the garment laid flat and photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle on a hairline measurement grid, thin dimension leader lines at the shoulder, chest, sleeve and hem, structured spec column on the right. Lighting: even high-key 5500K from the camera axis with minimal shadow and one thin contact shadow along the flat-lay edges. Background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel. Props: one plain wooden hanger parked outside the grid. The garment occupies 45-50% of the frame. Text zone: serif masthead reading 「{callout_9}」; four horizontal index scales labeled 「厚薄」「版型」「衣长」「弹力」 with five evenly spaced tick words and one solid triangular marker each; a five-column size grid where the header row and all cell values are filled from the supplied product data, never invented. Clean structured layout, no dense body text. Negative: no invented measurements, no fabricated grades, no unreadable tiny text, no missing units, no watermark, no brand logo, no QR code, no floating garment without contact shadow, no perspective distortion of the straight grid lines.

shots.intent: 以平铺全貌与做工印记收口全页，把决策落点放在可见的工艺本身而非任何资质口号。
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the laid-open garment with the inner edge and finish exposed
shots.lighting: soft high-key 5500K key from camera left with a wide bounce, shallow controlled highlights, honest contact shadow under the garment
shots.background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel with one #9E2A30 rule and a thin double zig-zag divider
shots.props: three flat circular seal badges in #9E2A30 and a folded swatch of the garments own lining edge
shots.whitespace: clear lower band kept open for the closing line

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust closing screen for {product}, laid open and photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so the inner edge and finish are exposed. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: close the page on verifiable craft instead of slogans. Composition: garment laid open across the panel, three flat circular seal badges aligned along the lower third, a folded swatch of the garments own lining edge beside them, clear lower band reserved for the closing line. Lighting: soft high-key 5500K key from camera left with a wide bounce, controlled highlights, honest contact shadow grounding the garment. Background: flat #F7F5F2 print panel with one #9E2A30 rule and a thin double zig-zag divider. Props: three seal badges and one lining-edge swatch. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame. Text zone: serif masthead reading 「{callout_10}」, three 10pt badge captions and one closing line reading 「{selling_point_6}」 in #2D2D2D. Quiet premium finish. Negative: do not invent certifications, awards, lab reports, ratings, sales figures or discounts; no fake seals, no watermark, no brand logo, no QR code or member entry point, no dense body text, no floating garment, no smoothed texture.

provenance.notes: 12 片切片逐片读图，有效信息片为 01-07，08-12 多为未加载占位块与模板残留（含竖排英文模板字、重复的段落占位文案、会员二维码入口），全部剔除并转成通用版式规则。品类以图为准：L1 女装与源夹「女装 (33)」一致，L2 取外套（开襟短款坎肩式外套，非上衣、非裙装），无源夹不符情况。已剥离：源图模特面部与身份、原刊头英文大字与逐字文案、品牌字段与联系方式、二维码与会员入口、原始品名与原料品种指称、面料分类科普段、逐格尺码数值与具体号型、指数刻度具体档位、重复装饰跑马灯字。所有规格数值与色号一律改为占位符并由生成时的产品数据注入，不做任何编造。差异化说明：库内 8 个女装模版为毛呢外套、吊带裙、风衣、牛仔短裙、娃娃领连衣裙、雪纺上衣、连帽卫衣、纯棉短袖，均无撞质拼接的毛面+光面开襟坎肩廓形；本模版视觉体系为涂鸦水泥墙低机位杂志封面 + #F7F5F2 纸白编辑版面 + #9E2A30 圆形印记，与既有 8 版的清透棚拍与学院风口径不重叠。
